Naseeruddin Shah rejects lifetime achievement awards, vows to continue acting

Veteran actor Naseeruddin Shah has stated he has no plans to retire and has recently turned down multiple lifetime achievement awards. He explained that such awards signify an end to one's work, which he does not feel is the case for him. Shah made these remarks at a success party celebrating his film "Main Vaapas Aaunga" completing 50 days in theatres, where he also expressed gratitude to the audience for their support.
